Subject: Unexpected P99 latency spike — immediate help requested

Hi Soojin,

We started seeing a sharp increase in P95/P99 latency on our hosted endpoints this morning (US-WEST-2 region). Baselines were ~120ms p95 / 320ms p99 yesterday; this morning p95 is ~320ms and p99 is spiking to 1.6s+. Throughput is degraded and a few requests have timed out.

This appears correlated to the canary we flipped yesterday (model tag v3-quant-bf16-variantB) — traffic is ~10% canary. The impact is most visible on sequences >1024 tokens. I attached traces and a heatmap.

Short summary attached:
- p95: 320ms -> 900ms
- p99: 320ms -> 1600ms
- Error rate: 0.2% -> 0.8% (timeouts)

We are on a tight launch schedule and need this stabilized ASAP. Can you triage and advise immediate mitigation? We can join a call.

Thanks,
Sneha Patel
Lead ML Engineer, TheoremAI

Team — we have an external escalation from TheoremAI (cc: Sneha, Arjun). Early signal points to the canary (v3-quant-bf16-variantB). Proposed immediate playbook:
1) Snapshot traffic split and stop new canary assignments (freeze rollout).
2) Collect engine-level traces and quantization fallback logs.
3) If evidence points to variantB, schedule a one-click rollback to v3-quant-bf16-variantA for 100% of traffic to remove variability.
4) Monitor p95/p99 in 5-minute buckets and report back at :15/:30.

I attached the current canary config diff for quick review.

Date: 2027-04-11T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Escalation: TheoremAI P99 spike — findings and mitigation plan

Quick update from on-call triage:
- Observed a 40x increase in kernel fallback events for variantB at sequence lengths >1024. Fallback path drops throughput and increases tail latency on our A100 fleet.
- KV cache miss rate for variantB is ~18% higher in canary instances vs baseline.
- Heatmap aligns with Theorem traces attached.

Immediate mitigation we executed (10:02 PDT):
- Paused new canary rollouts and marked variantB as quarantined.
- Initiated rollback command (one-click) to route all traffic to v3-quant-bf16-variantA.

To rollback manually:
redwoodctl rollout set --deployment theoremai-prod --model-tag v3-quant-bf16-variantA --confirm

Monitoring: watching p95/p99 across canary and baseline pools. Will follow up in 15 minutes with numbers.

Ethan
On-call — Serving Runtime
